purpose: HTTP/UI readiness credential for BATCH-31 and BATCH-32 unlock.

headers.X-Request-Id: client generated UUID per HTTP call

http_contract.error_envelope_policy: UI consumes ApiResult<T>; network and timeout failures are converted to { data:null, error:{ code, message, retryable }, request_id }.

notification_confirmation_before_consume.rule: Consumer-facing agent reply enters the chat only after the operator confirms the resolution path.
evidence: frontend/src/App.tsx handleEvaluate only sets draft and approvalReply before confirmation.
frontend/src/App.tsx handleApprove appends the agent message and service receipt only after approveResolution succeeds.
frontend/src/App.tsx shipment proactive_notification_draft is rendered as status/progress information after backend success, not as a pre-confirmation consumer chat send.
consumer_chat_mutation_points: handleApprove success path: appends AGENT message after backend approval.
handleShipment success path: appends STATUS message after backend shipment response.

retry_keeps_same_idempotency_key.rule: State-changing operations carry caller-generated idempotency_key; retry of the same logical operation must reuse the same key and body.
evidence: frontend/src/api/contracts.ts marks approveResolution and pushShipmentEvent as requiresIdempotencyKey=true.
schemas/approve-resolution-request.schema.json requires idempotency_key with minLength 8.
schemas/shipment-event-request.schema.json requires idempotency_key with minLength 8.
backend/main.py stores idempotency by operation, case_id and idempotency_key; same canonical body returns first response; changed body returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
docs/08-idempotency-and-ordering.md section 3 defines replay semantics.

retry_policy.manual_retry_requirement: Reuse the exact original request body and idempotency_key for the same logical approve/shipment operation.
retry_policy.conflict_behavior: Same key with different body returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT and must not be rendered as success.

network_failure_never_displays_success.rule: Network and timeout failure produce error envelope and no success toast, no chat append and no responsibility-state mutation.
evidence: frontend/src/api/client.ts catch branch returns data=null and error.code INTERNAL_ERROR or MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.
frontend/src/App.tsx handleApprove checks result.error before setAccountability, setPhase, chat append or success toast.
frontend/src/App.tsx handleShipment checks result.error before setAccountability, status append or success toast.
ui_behavior_on_failure: do not append consumer-facing success message
do not mark shipment, approval or resolution as successful

ui_uses_backend_state_only.rule: Responsibility state changes are derived from backend ApiResult data, not from local optimistic success.
evidence: frontend/src/App.tsx handleApprove sets accountability from result.data.accountability_state only after success.
frontend/src/App.tsx handleShipment sets accountability, follow_up_candidate and supervisor_escalation_candidate from result.data only after success.
docs/04-responsibility-loop.md states event buttons call backend interfaces and must not directly modify frontend responsibility state.

event_time_advances_on_legal_branches.rule: Shipment event time must be monotonic and branch-legal; an earlier pickup after a later not-picked-up event is not accepted as success.
evidence: backend/main.py rejects event_time earlier than last_event_times[case_id].
backend/main.py rejects SHIPMENT_DELIVERED unless current shipment stage is IN_TRANSIT.
frontend/src/mockApi.test.ts rejects direct delivery and closes only after pickup then delivery.
docs/08-idempotency-and-ordering.md section 4 defines monotonic event_time and legal delivery transition.

no_frontend_reset_as_recovery.rule: Frontend must not reset local state to simulate recovery; recovery state comes from approve/shipment backend responses.
evidence: frontend/src/App.tsx handleSelectCase clears stale UI decision while loading a case; it does not synthesize service recovery.
frontend/src/mockApi.ts resetMockState is limited to demo/test isolation and is not used as a production recovery path.
docs/04-responsibility-loop.md states event buttons call backend interfaces and do not directly modify responsibility state.
allowed_resets: case switching clears stale decision/loading UI
test/demo isolation reset before a test case
disallowed_resets: resetting case_status to IN_FULFILLMENT after an error
clearing AT_RISK without a backend shipment response
